items.headline: ALB vs. SQM: Which Lithium Stock Should You Bet on Now?
items.snippet: ALB expects lithium demand CAGR of 10-20% 2025-2030, growth trending near the higher end of a 15-40% range this year; company continuing high-return capacity expansion projects.

items.headline: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Albemarle, Sociedad Quimica and Rio Tinto
items.snippet: ALB stock broke below its 50-day SMA on May 15, 2026, and below its 200-day SMA on June 23, 2026; 50-day SMA below 200-day SMA following a death cross on July 21, 2026, signaling a bearish trend. Longer-term lithium demand growth (EV penetration) still cited as supportive.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: RBC has an outperform rating on Albemarle and decreased the company's price target to $157 from $166, citing demand growth outpacing added supply despite lithium prices coming off somewhat in Q2.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245, keeps Buy rating, citing cost efficiencies, capital discipline and resilient lithium demand vs constrained supply.
